# TSBS DevOps — High CPU Usage - 12 Hours

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Hosts with sustained high CPU usage

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  hostname,
  COUNT(*) AS high_cpu_count
FROM cpu
WHERE
  usage_user > 90 AND time >= '2024-01-02 08:00:00' AND time < '2024-01-02 20:00:00'
GROUP BY
  hostname
HAVING
  COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY
  high_cpu_count DESC
```
